sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): a hunched beast's trot, the lower legs stepping in turn in place (never crossing), the body bobbing with each step, the claw and the blade carried as the pale figure has them
sheets.weapons: The near hand (image left) is the big cream CLAW, the far hand (image right) grips the curved bone BLADE with the dark red tip.
